_doc: Merge the role-seat entries under agents.providers into the existing Paseo config; remove _doc and replace <KIT> with the absolute path.
Lead/Peer use the project workspace. Supervisor uses ~/work/SUPERVISOR and must check its CWD.
Credentials are shared from ~/.codex or EPISTEX_CODEX_HOME.
Profiles live under daemon.agentProfiles; see SETUP.md. Profiles contain model selection only, not role prompts.
